records.text: Charlie Kirk said the Butler shooter had been identified by the Secret Service three hours before the shooting and that a roof 120 yards from Donald Trump was left unattended.
records.speaker: Charlie Kirk

appearances.snippet: Two bullets went right by him, one of which hit him and he got shot. We now know that the shooter was identified by Secret Service three hours before him, that there was a roof unattended, 120 yards away from Trump (Donald Trump).

verification.notes: Official FBI chronology says law enforcement identified Crooks as suspicious shortly after 5:00 p.m. and the shooting occurred about 6:11 p.m., not three hours later. Official reviews do confirm that the nearby AGR roof was unsecured and within roughly 150 yards of the stage. One clause is wrong and one is substantially supported.

sources.title: FBI Investigative Updates on the Butler Assassination Attempt
sources.relevance: Official chronology places suspicious-person identification about one hour before the shooting and documents roof access.

sources.title: Independent Review Panel Final Report on Butler
sources.relevance: Official review confirms the unsecured AGR roof was less than 150 yards from the stage.

records.text: Charlie Kirk accused police and the Secret Service of doing nothing while the Butler shooter climbed a ladder with a rifle and set up.
records.speaker: Charlie Kirk

appearances.snippet: climbed the ladder with a rifle, set himself up. People saw him, Trump (Donald Trump) supporters. Police did nothing. Secret Service did nothing.

verification.notes: The FBI directly contradicts the ladder account: Crooks left the purchased ladder near home and accessed the roof using HVAC equipment and piping. A local officer was then boosted to the roof, confronted Crooks, and radioed that he was armed before Crooks fired. It is therefore inaccurate to say police simply did nothing while he climbed a ladder and set up.

sources.title: FBI Investigative Updates on the Butler Assassination Attempt
sources.relevance: Official FBI findings refute ladder use and document a local officer confronting the armed shooter on the roof.

records.text: Charlie Kirk predicted that no one would probably be held accountable for the Butler assassination attempt.
records.speaker: Charlie Kirk

appearances.snippet: No one has been fired. No one has resigned. And no one will probably be held accountable. But this is one of the strangest, most suspicious stories in American history.
